title: Improving Cross-Cultural Survey Simulation with Calibrated Value Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting model-generated survey responses onto the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and comparing Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and response diversity against human data from the World Values Survey to evaluate the model's default bias toward WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) populations.

Measuring the predictive performance gap between countries that are overrepresented in LLM training data (e.g., the United Kingdom) and those that are underrepresented (e.g., Ghana, Moldova) using different prompting strategies including country-specific roleplay.
